name: Tyree Mannings
strengths: Mannings creates clear cushion on vertical go routes — defenders cannot stay stride-for-stride.
Mannings tracks the ball through traffic and wins contested catches with strong hands at the catch point.
Mannings turns short completions into yards after contact with quick feet and lateral agility.
weaknesses: Mannings is still filling out the 6-0 / 170 frame — added mass will help him finish through SEC press.
comparison: Mannings comps to Chris Olave — 6-0 / 187 mold; sudden vertical separation and clean tracking at the catch point.
projection: Mannings projects as early WR-room contributor who rotates Year 1–2, then starter upside as a vertical separator with YAC.
schemeFit: Mannings fits Marcus Davis / Trent McKnight rooms that want sudden separators who win downfield and after the catch.
